notes.title: Update build 461626 - The long wait is over!
notes.notes:
Shufflepuck Cantina Deluxe has now landed into the VR crowd!

Set foot in Virtual Reality for good, battle the worst scum and villains this side of space harbors thanks to a complete and exclusive support of Oculus Rift DK1 and DK2 headsets.

[b]An adventure inspired by classic arcade games from a brand new perspective![/b]
[list]
[*]Complete support of Oculus Rift DK1 and DK2 headsets.
[*]The most advanced 3D VR game interface ever built.
[*]Precise tuning sets a new standard for VR ease of use.
[*]An unbelievably immersive Virtual Presence experience.
[*]A game system designed as an ideal first experience for all VR players.
[*]Intelligent headset presence detection for streamlined usage.
[*]Motion tracking (DK2): lean around the table to get closer to the action!
[/list]

[img]http://pressrelease.aghartastudio.com/images/scdvr-gif-2.gif[/img]

notes.title: Oculus Rift full support, release date
notes.notes:
Ladies and Gentleman, Clean up your Rifts!
The upcoming major update will bring you Shufflepuck Cantina Deluxe VR on 5 Dec 2014.
(Look at the game's release date for a funny fact!)

Quote from a lucky early reviewer:
"There are good VR games, and there are others... Good ones are designed to work on VR from the start, Shufflepuck Cantina Deluxe VR seems to be one of the firsts. Agharta Studio succeded at sublimating its game sceneries and ambiance, this little title may not look much but promises to be one of the first VR successes!"
- factornews.com

[img]http://pressrelease.aghartastudio.com/images/scdvr-gif-1.gif[/img]

notes.title: French Indie Sale - Up To 80% Off Popular French Indie Games
notes.notes:
Celebrate top French independent game developers with the French Indie Sale, running today on Steam!

Organized by Seaven Studio together with over dozen other French indie developers, the promotion features 15 innovative French indie games. Pick from hits like Evoland, Fly’N, Strike Vector and gems like Tetrobot and Co., Type:Rider, Ethan: Meteor Hunter and many more!

All of these titles are discounted on Steam starting Sept 17 at 10 am Pacific Time for 48h only until Sept 19 at 10am Pacific time.

For more details, and the full list of titles on sale, please see http://store.steampowered.com/sale/frenchindiesale

notes.title: Exclusive Bonus Content
notes.notes:
With this brand new content update, Oculus Rift owners can opt into an awesome new beta for an ultimate air hockey experience!
Exclusive to Steam users, the immersive Oculus VR edition of the game features redesigned user interfaces blended into the environment, easy to read texts and dialogs, and intensive air hockey goodness right in front of you, really!
Updated game engine to natively support the Oculus Rift on Windows, Mac and Linux.
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/video/259510/2030851]Check this video out![/url]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Shufflepuck Cantina Deluxe
notes.notes:
Shufflepuck Cantina Deluxe is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

After "accidentally" jumping your spaceship through a wormhole, you’ve crash landed onto this forsaken desert planet a billion kilometers from home. The only thing between you and the horizon is the seemingly endless dunes of sand, save for one strange, huge building. Inside, it appears to be an interstellar Casino where everyone plays air hockey for a living.

You’ll have to fight hard to grind down all your opponents until they are utterly defeated to earn the critical parts needed to repair your ship. Once you’ve obtained all the spaceship pieces you’ll have to defeat the owner of this insane Casino so you can go home.

Offer ends December 13th at 10am PST*
